description.en: Google Cloud Vertex AI Express Mode provider with native Gemini protocol support.
description.zh: Google Cloud Vertex AI Express Mode 提供商，原生支持 Gemini 协议。

description.en: Enter a Vertex AI Express Mode API key and upload a Google Cloud credential JSON file to refresh the model list online.
description.zh: 填写 Vertex AI Express Mode API Key，并上传 Google Cloud 凭证 JSON 文件以在线刷新模型列表。

help_text.en: Select a service account key JSON or authorized_user ADC JSON file. Used to refresh the model list; the API key above is used for inference.
help_text.zh: 选择服务账号密钥 JSON 或 authorized_user ADC JSON 文件，用于刷新模型列表；上方 API Key 用于模型调用。
